description: Returns the status of a conversion. When it is finished, download_url is the target file when the API offers that link, otherwise the default link. filename is the API's name for that file when the result includes one. output has the target format and, when the API sends a size, bytes. other_downloads lists the remaining zip, 7z, and default links. An image result omits triangles.
name: get_conversion
title: Get conversion result
